source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Stress  Mini DP function by BurnIn.
1. Install BurnIN tool under OS.
2. Check system information
3. Select Configuration > Test Selection & Duty Cycles.
4. Select Grsphics and set to 100%
5. Set auto stop after 180 Minutes (3hrs)
5. Start selected test and run Burn-in 3 hrs
6. Check Burn-in result and event log.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1.BurnIN results should have no error.0
2.Graphic card after BurnIN still can work normally.
3.BurnIN can run 3 hrs successfully.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- "Burnin 3 hours" stresses the Mini-DP/display function with the licensed BurnInTest tool; install the user-supplied BurnInTest binary, configure the 3h run, execute, and return the report. Multi-step + long-running + licensed.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL BurnInTest report (duration + pass/fail per test) so the user confirms the 3h burnin passed on the Mini-DP stress.

original_test_intent: Run the licensed BurnInTest Graphics workload at 100% duty for the full 180 minutes to stress the MiniDP/graphics path, retain an error-free raw report and verify post-run graphics and log health.
original_method: Install the approved BurnInTest package, record system information, select Graphics at 100%, configure auto-stop at 180 minutes, execute once under monitoring, then collect the complete report, event logs and post-test graphics state.
manual_activity: No inherently human core acceptance is specified. A licensed package, approved configuration and one-user approval are readiness inputs; the agent can drive the configured tool, monitor it and collect all electronic evidence. An engineer owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Licensed BurnInTest installer/version/hash/license and supported OS
Exact Graphics test selection, 100% duty-cycle configuration and report path
SUT/GPU/MiniDP/driver/display identity and expected post-test function
Temperature/power limits, sampling cadence, abort mechanism, maintenance window and OOB recovery
Owner clarification that 'no error.0' means zero reported errors
safety_requirements: Do not install an unknown or unlicensed package or substitute another workload.
Verify cooling, power capacity and an independent recovery path before a three-hour 100% graphics run.
Monitor approved thermal/power/GPU/display/BMC limits and execute Safety Stop when crossed.
Do not clear baseline logs, conceal tool errors or automatically retry an interrupted/failed run.
agent_execution_scope: Validate package identity, capture baseline configuration/health and request approval for the unchanged 180-minute plan.
Configure the source-specified Graphics 100% duty and auto-stop, execute once and monitor approved safety telemetry.
Collect the complete unfiltered report, duration/configuration, monitoring samples, event logs and post-test graphics health; report Tool Result separately.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve the licensed package, exact configuration, limits and recovery plan.
Ensure the SUT environment supports the approved uninterrupted window.
Review raw evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually correct but not an executable command. Package/version-specific GUI or documented CLI details must be verified from the supplied licensed tool; the long duration alone does not make capability partial.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use BurnInTest's approved GUI automation or documented command interface for the exact version. Preserve the original Graphics 100%, 180-minute auto-stop and raw report; do not invent flags.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BurnInTest, Graphics 100%, 180 minutes/3 hours, post-result/event checks and 15/180-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a versioned BurnInTest configuration selecting only the intended Graphics workload at 100%, prove the 180-minute auto-stop, collect raw output plus synchronized GPU temperature/power/display/BMC telemetry and perform deterministic post-run health checks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact licensed BurnInTest version, OS, GPU/driver and MiniDP path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record rather than assume the tool/version/license and configuration checksum.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Supplied BurnInTest vendor documentation/license and owner-approved platform limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible configuration, safety monitoring and evidence timestamps without replacing BurnInTest.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No workload or duration reduction; alternate stress tools are not equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Automated health data may not capture subjective artifacts unless the project separately requires human visual evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve another duration or duty cycle, but the result must state that project-plan coverage and cannot claim the source 180 minutes unless completed. Package/license/approval inputs do not make an automatable core PARTIAL or permanently BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Package/version/hash/license, SUT/GPU/MiniDP identity and configuration checksum/screens
Raw report proving Graphics 100%, 180-minute configured/elapsed run and zero tool errors under the clarified rule
Time-series thermal/power/GPU/display and BMC health with any Safety Stop evidence
Post-run graphics/device/log health, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Duplicated step number is editorial. 'No error.0' requires owner interpretation but is consistent with the zero-error intent and does not contradict the three-hour method.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The specified tool, workload, duty and duration are clear. Package/license and project safety values are readiness inputs, not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain the exact BurnInTest dependency and raw report, but reject PARTIAL solely because the package is licensed/user-supplied and the run is long.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its detailed safety/configuration controls, but reclassify to FULLY AUTOMATABLE because all core actions and evidence are automatable after approval.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates capability, readiness, Tool Result and Engineer Verdict and prevents duration/package from lowering classification.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact licensed workload and full 180-minute coverage while adding machine-verifiable configuration, continuous safeguards and truthful project-override reporting.
independent_technical_reasoning: Installation, GUI/CLI configuration, timed execution, telemetry, report parsing and post-health checks are all machine-executable. Package provision and one approval affect readiness, not capability, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is the V3.1 result.
